source.note: Huige Cheng's competition technical report; distinct from the MIND dataset paper.

training.interaction: flatten field concat [15*100] then upper-triangle pairwise dot products i<j in lexicographic order; 105 values; total 1605
training.loss: mean sigmoid cross entropy from logits over labeled candidates
training.optimizer: tf.keras.optimizers.Adam from the TensorFlow/Keras 2.15 compatibility environment; reimplementation, not verified as upstream bert-adam
training.optimizer_algorithm_note: Keras Adam bias-corrected moment update; exact upstream bert-adam bias correction, epsilon placement, clipping, weight decay, and sparse-gradient semantics unresolved
training.schedule: ceil(0.1*updates) linear warmup then linear decay to min over one epoch
training.schedule_step_convention: zero-based update counter; assign learning_rate_at(update) before apply_gradients, increment update after the optimizer step
training.per_impression_rng: SHA256(base_seed, split, impression_id) -> uint32 -> NumPy RandomState MT19937; shuffle positions once, negatives assigned permutation[position] modulo 5; positives retained in every partition
training.impression_order: deterministic shuffled train impression IDs, seed 20261110
training.train_candidate_did_mask: source ratio -1 means all candidate DIDs retained in train
training.train_did_membership: unique DIDs in either history or candidate impressions of raw train behaviors.tsv; excludes news metadata and does not use click labels
training.dev_checkpoint_selection_mask: dev_new_did_masked: deterministic keyed 92% mask per candidate occurrence, applied only when candidate DID is absent from train behavior history+candidate membership; seen DIDs are retained; content lookup/text preserved
training.dev_mask_rng_unit: candidate occurrence keyed by (dev_mask_seed, impression_id, candidate_position); distinct occurrences of one unseen DID receive independent deterministic draws
training.dev_mask_source_difference: follows Technical Report intent; pinned executable util.mask_dids(valid) instead masks all DID tensor entries and ignores dids_in_train; exact upstream runtime behavior therefore conflicts with report intent
training.test_candidate_did_mask: candidate DID absent from raw train behavior history+candidate membership -> UNK; history and content lookup unchanged
training.initializer: existing encoder initializers and Keras Dense GlorotUniform/zero bias defaults; nonhistorical numerical equivalence not claimed
training.resume: strict TensorFlow restore includes model, Adam slots, optimizer iterations, update counter, examples_seen cursor, and schedule index; counters must align; saved optimizer LR must match the prior schedule step within rtol=1e-6/atol=1e-12; cursor must equal min(update*effective_batch_size, selected_candidates); deterministic sampler is replayed from its locked seed; run config and actual database content fingerprint must match
training.split_policy: train-only partition training; dev full unsampled; test labels prohibited

reimplementation_decisions: The active architecture intentionally omits source cur_body and his_body fields; it is not the source 17-field body model.
The preprocessing section preserves the existing body-v17 stage-01 fingerprint and SQLite layout. Body columns may remain in the prepared DB; the active model loader does not read them.
Word vectors are the local title+abstract MIND GloVe reimplementation; entity vectors are locally derived from the supplied MIND artifact. Their provenance is stored beside the matrices.
Query-free masked attention for his_id is a disclosed choice; the exact private PoolingWrapper('att') query use remains unverified.
Private gezi/melt/husky components are not replaced by similarly named packages. Attention/DIN/pooling implementations are independent reimplementations.
Keras Adam remains the active optimizer implementation. The source shell names bert-adam, but the exact runtime dispatch/dependency binding is not proven; no equivalence claim is made.

The source shell contains batch-size flags 4096 in common.sh and 1024 appended by base.sh; the technical report states batch_size=1024. This local contract uses effective batch 1024 and microbatch 16 with accumulation.
